stories.title: Atlético - Real Madrid en directo | Rüdiger recorta distancias en el minuto 89

en.title: Atlético - Real Madrid live | Rüdiger closes the gap in minute 89
en.summary: Grimaldo scored a penalty for Atlético and David extended the lead, but Real Madrid's Rüdiger scored late. Huijsen received a red card for fouling Simeone as the last defender.

stories.title: Italia se plantea prohibir el uso del burka y el niqab en la escuela y limitar el número de extranjeros por clase

en.title: Italy considers banning burka and niqab use in schools and limiting the number of foreigners per class
en.summary: Italy's far-right president Giorgia Meloni announced plans to bring restrictions on Islamic face coverings in schools and limits on foreign students per classroom to the Council of Ministers.

stories.title: Moscú denuncia "el mayor ataque de la historia" por parte de Ucrania contra la capital, que deja al menos dos muertos y varios heridos

en.title: Moscow denounces "the greatest attack in history" by Ukraine against the capital, leaving at least two dead and several wounded
en.summary: Russian Defense Ministry stated it intercepted 1,100 Ukrainian drones across the country, with 450 over Moscow, resulting in casualties during an attack on the capital.

stories.title: Ucrania lanza su mayor ataque sobre Moscú en el último día de elecciones rusas

en.title: Ukraine launches its largest attack on Moscow on the final day of Russian elections
en.summary: Ukraine carried out a major attack on Moscow during Russian elections, with President Zelenski acknowledging the offensive while calling for Russia to end the war and pursue peace.

stories.title: Meloni anuncia una ley para limitar un número máximo de extranjeros por aula en colegios

en.title: Meloni announces law to limit maximum number of foreign students per classroom in schools
en.summary: Italy's government is proposing legislation to cap the number of foreign students in classrooms and require parents of foreign students with integration difficulties to ensure their children learn Italian. The measure also bans burqas and headscarves in educational institutions.

stories.title: Pedro Acosta logra, por fin, su primera victoria, Martín sale más líder y Márquez sufre

en.title: Pedro Acosta achieves his first victory at last, Martín extends lead and Márquez suffers
en.summary: Pedro Acosta secured his maiden victory in the premier motorcycle racing category at the Austrian circuit, rebounding from a previous sprint race crash. Jorge Martín finished second and increased his championship lead.

stories.title: Acosta se lleva en Austria su primer Gran Premio y Jorge Martín es más líder

en.title: Acosta wins his first Grand Prix in Austria and Jorge Martín extends his lead
en.summary: Acosta claimed his debut Grand Prix victory in Austria after recovering from a sprint race error, while series leader Jorge Martín finished second. Marc Márquez placed fifth in the race.

stories.title: Feijóo pide una política migratoria “ordenada” y promete cerrar España “a cal y canto” a quienes vengan “a saltarse la ley”

en.title: Feijóo calls for "orderly" migration policy and promises to close Spain "hermetically" to those coming to "break the law"
en.summary: Spain's conservative opposition leader reiterates his proposal to review nationality granting and withdrawal procedures while criticizing the government over the Ceuta migration crisis.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran califica de “injustificable” la actuación de Israel en Gaza y reconoce “errores” tras apartar de su gira al rapero Macklemore

en.title: Ed Sheeran calls Israel's actions in Gaza "unjustifiable" and acknowledges "mistakes" after removing rapper Macklemore from his tour
en.summary: Ed Sheeran stated that Israel's conduct in Gaza is unjustifiable and admitted to making difficult decisions regarding his tour following controversy over removing a supporting artist who expressed pro-Palestine views.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran reaparece tras la polémica por el apoyo de su extelonero a Palestina: «Lo que está ocurriendo en Gaza es injustificable»

en.title: Ed Sheeran reappears after controversy over his opening act's support for Palestine: "What is happening in Gaza is unjustifiable"
en.summary: Ed Sheeran, previously politically neutral, publicly stated during a concert that the situation in Gaza is catastrophic and unjustifiable, breaking his silence following the removal of rapper Macklemore from his tour.

stories.title: Moscú y su región sufren “el mayor ataque de la historia” en el último día de las elecciones en Rusia

en.title: Moscow and its region suffer "the largest attack in history" on the final day of Russian elections
en.summary: Air defense systems intercepted 450 Ukrainian drones heading toward Moscow, though the city's mayor reported 1,600 drones in the previous 24 hours during Russia's election period.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran se posiciona en su primer concierto tras el despido de Macklemore: “Lo que está sucediendo en Gaza es injustificable”

en.title: Ed Sheeran positions himself at first concert after Macklemore's dismissal: "What is happening in Gaza is unjustifiable"
en.summary: Ed Sheeran addressed the controversy surrounding a rapper's removal from his tour over Palestinian support statements during his concert performance.

stories.title: Volvo Cars nombra a Klaus Zellmer futuro presidente y CEO de la compañía sueca

en.title: Volvo Cars appoints Klaus Zellmer as future president and CEO of the Swedish company
en.summary: Klaus Zellmer, current CEO of Skoda Auto, will replace Hakan Samuelsson as head of Geely-owned Volvo Cars, with the transition occurring by October 1, 2027 at the latest.

stories.title: España recurre a las redes sociales para desalentar las entradas irregulares a Ceuta y Melilla

en.title: Spain uses social media to discourage irregular entries to Ceuta and Melilla
en.summary: Spain is running a social media campaign informing people that entering Ceuta and Melilla irregularly does not grant the right to access mainland Spain, remain in the country, or freely travel within the European Union.

stories.title: Meloni anuncia una ley para limitar el número de extranjeros por aula en los colegios

en.title: Meloni announces law to limit number of foreigners per classroom in schools
en.summary: Italian Prime Minister Meloni announced that a draft law to restrict the number of foreign students in school classrooms will be presented at the next Council of Ministers.

stories.title: Trump anuncia que creará la 'Fuerza IA' y nombrará un 'zar' para dirigirla

en.title: Trump announces he will create 'AI Force' and appoint a 'czar' to lead it
en.summary: Trump announced plans to establish an artificial intelligence force and designate a leader to oversee it.

stories.title: La inteligencia artificial destapa trabajos sin sentido que estaban ocultos

en.title: Artificial intelligence uncovers meaningless jobs that were hidden
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is revealing unnecessary tasks embedded within legitimate professions, eliminating busywork rather than eliminating essential jobs themselves.
